neighbours.label: The smallest scale of matter: particle-physics and quantum-level prose (subatomic particles, accelerators, antimatter, the Planck scale), predicting 'subatomic'/'particle'
fire: Every electron is a fundamental particle carrying one unit of negative charge.
Three quarks bind together to make each proton and neutron.
Inside the Large Hadron Collider, protons collide at nearly the speed of light.
In quantum field theory, each particle is an excitation of an underlying field.
Billions of neutrinos pass through your body every second without interacting.
The Higgs boson is what gives the other particles their mass.
Hadrons are built from quarks held together by the strong force.
Down at the Planck scale, space itself may turn out to be grainy.
quiet: Every red dwarf is a small star burning its hydrogen very slowly.
Three tectonic plates meet beneath the island, which explains the earthquakes.
Inside the reactor vessel, water is heated to produce steam for the turbines.
In plate tectonics, each continent rides on a slab of rigid lithosphere.
Billions of bacteria live in your gut and help digest fibre.
The mitochondrion is what gives the cell most of its energy.
Proteins are built from amino acids joined by peptide bonds.
Out at the edge of the solar system, the Sun's influence finally fades.

predictions: Particle-physics items reach 0.3-0.7 on the function word before the particle term; astronomy, geology, cell biology and classical mechanics in the same sentence shapes stay under 0.15. The reactor-vessel item is the hardest near miss.
notes: Probe: neutrino is a subatomic particle 0.695 (peak ' a'), Standard Model at the subatomic level 0.623 (' how'), Dirac predicted antimatter 0.390, particle accelerator 0.310, quantum level vacuum 0.274; Cepheid astronomy 0.068, chemistry pH 0.053, inclined plane 0.038, orchestra 0.050. The + pole's logit effect suppresses ' sub'/' particles'/' matter', so this pole promotes the subatomic vocabulary: it fires on the function word before it.
